summary: Wide grass verge on a quiet street, homes about 15 m behind fences.
reasons: Homes 12-16 m away on this side
Wide mown verge gives room to stop
No parked cars to blend in

drivers.seclusion: Houses and a long shed sit behind fences 12-16 m from the kerb; more homes across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a wide mown verge on the west side; plenty of room to pull clear.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street between two cross streets; little traffic likely.
drivers.convention: Almost no cars parked here, so a van would stand out.

flags: Few parked cars, van would be noticed
sun_shade: Open; sparse trees, full sun from the east and west.

best_section.where: Murray Street west kerb, midway between the two cross streets, beside the long shed
